## Current gap and impact

What is missing, incorrect or outdated, and who or what does it affect?
Link the relevant page, example, workflow, dependency advisory or other evidence.

## Desired result and scope

Explain why the change is needed and how completion can be verified.
Keep small changes brief; feature or public behavior changes need the feature rationale.

## Related work

Link existing issues or PRs. Any implementation PR must link this issue and explain
how it addresses the gap, including bot-generated dependency PRs.
